question:
The word MANGO has been coded using 4 different codes.

Code 1: NBOHP

Code 2: LZMFN

Code 3: OCPIQ

Code 4: NCQKT

Which of the given codes is used to write the word ORANGE as PTDRLK?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

**MANGO has been coded using 4 different codes:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/929e1b3035fe73f565280ad06035776ad501d966b6662128b6993d589405faf6.png] 

The logic followed here is: Increasing number series is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5193fb36ea405390db571cbc366dd442652361e3f82521081b9591402558616e.png]

Thus, to write the word ORANGE as PTDRLK, logic of Code - 4 is followed here.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
